plan.notes: Source: CT State 2026-2027 catalog, General Studies, AS (https://catalog.ctstate.edu/programs/general-studies-as/). General Education: ENG 1010 (3), MATH 1200 Statistics I (3), ARHX (3), SCRX/SCKX (3), HISX (3), ORAX (3), CCS 1001 (3). Program: WRIX (3); Arts & Humanities - two courses from two different disciplines (ART, ARTH, COMM, HUM, ENG, MUS, PHL, THR, ARAB, ASL, CHNS, FREN, GERM, ITAL, JAPN, LATN, POLH, RUSN, SPAN) (6); Social/Behavioral Science - two courses from ANTH, ECON, GEOG, POLS, PSY, SOC, or WGS (6); Science or Math elective - one course from ASTR, BIO, CHEM, ENV, ERTH, GEOL, HORT, METR, OCEN, PHYS, SCI, or MATH (3); Technological Literacy elective - one course from CIS, CSA, or GRA (3); open electives - 1000-level or above, no more than 15 credits from any one discipline (18). Official total 60-66; this file models the 60-credit path. Framework slots (ARHX, SCRX, SCKX, SBSX, WRIX, HISX, ORAX, GLKY, CRTY) are modeled as choice slots: any course approved for that CSCU Framework category satisfies the slot - see the catalog or an advisor for the approved list. Catalog notes: MATH 1100 Quantitative Reasoning recommended; ESOL 1402/1502 may substitute for one Arts & Humanities course; technological literacy excludes GRA 2201 and GRA 2202.
